sectionSubtitle: Discover the perks of community-driven reading.

features.title: Eco-Friendly Reading
features.description: Reduce paper waste by sharing books within your community instead of buying new copies.

features.title: Zero Cost
features.description: Access thousands of titles without the price tag of a bookstore. Reading shouldn't be a luxury.

features.title: Connect with Neighbors
features.description: Meet fellow bookworms in your area through our local 'Nest' pickup points.

features.title: Smart Reminders
features.description: Never worry about late fees with our automated SMS and email return notifications.
